lines.text: Do you know how a concert ticket stops fakes? The secret is in that little square code.
Every ticket gets its own code, a long random number that nobody could guess.
At the gate, the scanner reads it and checks a central list. Valid? The light turns green.
In that instant, the ticket is marked as used. So if someone copied it, the copy gets a red light.
Some ticket apps go further. The code changes every few seconds, so a screenshot is useless.
That's how thousands of people get through the gates in minutes, and the fakes don't.
Orbi gives every file its own QR code too. Scan it to land right on the file, and add a code, so only people who know it can open it.
